Reasoning: Let the five numbers be a, b, c, d, e from left to right, where c is the middle number. From the image/text, a = 2 and e = 12. The product of the first three numbers is abc = 30, so bc = 30 / 2 = 15. The product of the last three numbers is cde = 360, so cd = 360 / 12 = 30.
